Initial release of obspy-datacenter-client.

- Provides an overview of accessing earthquake data from various data centers using ObsPy.
- Details how to use the `obspy.clients.fdsn` module for waveform and metadata downloads.
- Summarizes available FDSN web services, routing options, and mass downloader functionality.
- Includes descriptions for other ObsPy client modules (IRIS, Earthworm, NEIC, SeedLink, Syngine).
- Highlights supported data types and formats for each service.
